sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kappa Serpentis"
sources.quote: Kappa Serpentis, Latinised from κ Serpentis, is a single, red-hued star in the constellation Serpens, in its head.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 868 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,803 K, so 67.945 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kappa Serpentis"
sources.quote: It has the proper name Gudja and the Flamsteed designation 35 Serpentis.
